2760-4279-4616.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-4616.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-4616.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

2459-5006-6797-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2459-5006-6797-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Rograkh, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

2131-2173-4574-4659--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2131-2173-4574-4659--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

2174-2645-3430-3664.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2174-2645-3430-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1395-5078-6791-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-7918.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2021-2060-5902-6627.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5663-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {2} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
5663-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

4872-5900-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Lilysplash Mentor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

4377-6568-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Y'shtola Rhul.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

112-6556-7426.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
112-6556-7426.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to Temur Battlecrier, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1292-3117-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-1322-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1579-5231-6972--112.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1579-5231-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3108-5256-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-5256-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

277-681-1315-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
277-681-1315-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

560-2835-4550-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2835-4550-6797.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Fecundity triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Repeat.

2558-5315-5727-6705.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
When the Frog enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

800-1129-4116.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
800-1129-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Harabaz Druid.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

1236-2018-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
When Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Rattleblaze Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Rattleblaze Scarecrow is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1336-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness, and has power 3 or greater.
1336-2608-4499.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat.

3705-5231-5997-5999.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

290-1978-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creaitng a token copy of Dreamstone Hedron that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 2.

394-4798-5014-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-4798-5014-5686.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat.

826-4275-4698.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling and Avatar of Woe do not have summoning sickness.
826-4275-4698.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's first ability by tapping it, giving Avatar of Woe all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Avatar of Woe by tapping it, destroying target creature.
When the creature dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping Avatar of Woe, Amoeboid Changeling and any other creatures that shared a creature type with it.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
You may also target another creature using Amoeboid Changeling after the first activation each turn to untap them when Faces of the Past's ability resolves.

104-609-2060-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
Mine Worker does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mine Worker.
104-609-2060-4222.description:
Activate Mine Worker by tapping it, causing you to gain at least 2 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Mine Worker.
Repeat.

396-2034-4013-4365.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

7-1441-4050-5270.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with +1/+1 counters on them.
7-1441-4050-5270.description:
Cast Bill the Pony by paying {W}.
When Bill the Pony enters the battlefield, it and Samwise trigger.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Bill the Pony trigger, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bill the Pony, adding {W}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Bill the Pony to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

643-1716-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Kazandu Tuskcaller does not have summoning sickness.
Kazandu Tuskcaller has at least two level counters on it.
643-1716-2534.description:
Activate Kazandu Tuskcaller by tapping it, creating a 3/3 Elephant creature token.
When the Elephant enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Maskwood Nexus, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Kazandu Tuskcaller.
Repeat.

711-1029-2033.notablePrerequisites: Fallowsage does not have summoning sickness.
711-1029-2033.description:
Activate Fallowsage by tapping it, adding {G}.
Fallowsage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Fallowsage.
Repeat.

985-1872-3003-5220.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Composite Golem dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Composite Golem on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem from the top of your library by paying at most {4}.
Repeat.

703-2902.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of Journey to Nowhere that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
The Journey to Nowhere tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities.
Resolve the first Journey to Nowhere token's trigger, exiling Astral Dragon.
Resolve the second Journey to Nowhere token's trigger, exiling the first Journey to Nowhere token.The first Journey to Nowhere token leaves the battlefield, returning Astral Dragon from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

225-539-1257-3147.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
